Use case: precise-object-edit. Convert ONLY the deliberately white foreground selection in this F1 markup to a clean luminance coverage mask on the SAME full 1536x1024 canvas. This is extraction of the added white selection, not a new silhouette or a redraw. Put every deliberately painted foreground pixel WHITE and all unpainted original room/background pixels BLACK. Preserve exact original coordinates, complete extent and anti-aliased edge coverage of every fine long hair strand/ribbon, hands/fingertips, entire open book including thin covers/page block/lower binding, whole skirt/hem, exposed knees, socks and both complete shoes including heels/full soles.
All foreground interior areas MUST be opaque white. The faint grey lines inside the added white book/hand/lap/shoe regions are foreground details, not background gaps: fill them WHITE, never make a black seam, slot or pinhole through the book, fingers, face, eyes, mouth, skirt, knees or shoes. Only real unpainted background gaps between hair strands and between the two legs stay black. Naturally pale original curtains, cushion, knitted throw, lamp/flowers/sky and sunlight remain BLACK; they were not deliberately painted white. No couch/floor/shadow receiver in this F mask. No new shadow, dilation, erosion, expanded halo, cut hair, clipped book corner, crop, resize, translation, outlines, gray photo texture, labels or checkerboard. One opaque neutral black-and-white 1536x1024 PNG, with only smooth edge greys for true coverage. It will mask original mother RGB, never provide colored replacement pixels.
